pick.headline: Arafat, Rabin and Peres awarded the Nobel Peace Prize
pick.summary: On October 14, 1994, the Nobel Committee awarded the Peace Prize to Yasir Arafat, Yitzhak Rabin and Shimon Peres for the Oslo accords.
pick.significance: The award marked the high point of the Oslo process.
